summary_for_children: Al-A'la means The Most High. It tells us to glorify Allah who created, proportioned and guided, who brings out pasture and turns it dark.
environment_concept: A wide field beside the path: one part fresh green pasture (87:4), and further on the same grass dried to dark stubble (87:5). The field slowly turns from green to dark and grows again, a picture of how short the life of this world is. The Fire of 87:12 is not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A grass field that changes colour over time, dry stubble rows.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A terraced hillside garden in spring with blossom trees and a potting shed holding a tall wooden seedling box

primary_mechanic.text: Inside a box with three shelves (gaps right, left, right), open one window at a time to guide a bean shoot toward the light round each shelf and out of the top; the wrong side leaves it pale under the shelf and is noted (87:3, measured out and guided).

secondary_activities: you will not forget (87:6-8, read; the Prophet is not shown)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading on the garden path, the seedling box, then a reading by the fence
world_assets: tall seedling box with side and top windows
environment_behaviour: the shoot is drawn growing round each shelf
it climbs out of the top of the box when guided all the way
unique_world.learning_objective: Know that Allah measured out and guided everything (87:2-3)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Remember and Grow
story_library.children_narration: The Quran invites us to remember Allah and appreciate His creation. Surah Al-A'la speaks about creation, growth, and guidance. It encourages people to remember what is truly important rather than becoming distracted by temporary things.

world_idea.title: The Mountain Meadow
world_idea.description: Explore the growth of plants through the seasons and follow a quiet learning path about remembrance and gratitude.
